purpose: Restore the evidence-backed manufacturing data, MES, historian, analytics and QMS research overlay required by the Integration Fabric. Documentation evidence only; no tenant certification and no write authority.

systems.name: Rockwell Automation FactoryTalk DataMosaix
systems.evidenceNote: Rockwell's current DataMosaix API reference documents REST APIs, M2M access, OpenAPI specifications, access tokens and Swagger UI. Catalog presence is documentation evidence only; no customer tenant was authenticated.

customerValue: Expose governed industrial data to workforce/production intelligence without inventing a plant-specific connector surface.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce manual extraction and reconciliation effort when labour decisions require contextualised production data.
constraintsRisks: Project roles and token scopes remain customer-specific; no write authority is enabled by this profile.

systems.name: AspenTech Inmation
systems.evidenceNote: Current Inmation documentation exposes Web API/HTTP integration and OPC UA client/server connectivity. The profile remains edge/read-first because endpoint certificates, model permissions and plant-network topology are deployment specific.

customerValue: Bridge historian/industrial signals into labour, readiness and production context through supported web and OPC UA surfaces.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce bespoke OT data plumbing and manual production-context reconciliation.
constraintsRisks: Plant-network access, OPC UA certificates and write permissions must be proven per site; cloud scanning is not assumed.

systems.name: Körber Werum PAS-X MES
systems.evidenceNote: Körber documents PAS-X open APIs and an OpenAPI specification, plus MSI/message-based shop-floor integration. API rate limits and regulated/GxP deployment controls require customer-specific validation.

customerValue: Relate workforce availability and skills to MES production execution while preserving regulated-system boundaries.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce manual MES-to-workforce reconciliation and accelerate response to labour-driven production risk.
constraintsRisks: GxP validation, API rate limits, MES version and customer interface governance must be established before operational actions.

systems.name: Seeq
systems.evidenceNote: Seeq documents its Server REST API and modern OData 4.0 export endpoints. Legacy OData exports were deprecated and modern endpoints should be used.

customerValue: Consume industrial analytics and OData exports as evidence for workforce/production decisions.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce spreadsheet handoffs between process analytics and labour planning.
constraintsRisks: Export availability, access keys and analysis visibility remain tenant/role specific; this profile grants no mutation authority.

systems.name: Canary Historian
systems.evidenceNote: Canary documents HTTPS web APIs and a native gRPC API for historian reads, with token-based authentication and optional tag-security permissions. VECTOR keeps historian writes disabled by default.

customerValue: Read high-resolution process/historian evidence alongside attendance, skills and labour allocation.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce manual correlation of plant events with workforce decisions and payroll/shift evidence.
constraintsRisks: Views, tag security, ports and site routing are deployment specific; edge placement is expected for many plants.

systems.name: TrendMiner
systems.evidenceNote: TrendMiner's current developer documentation points to its REST API and custom-connectivity developer portal. No customer tenant authentication has been performed.

customerValue: Use process analytics and contextual events as evidence when diagnosing production/labour deviations.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce analyst-to-supervisor handoffs when workforce action depends on process context.
constraintsRisks: Tenant API scopes and source-system entitlements must be validated before reading customer data.

systems.name: Honeywell Uniformance PHD
systems.evidenceNote: Honeywell identifies RESTful API, OPC UA, ODBC/OLEDB, Java and .NET alternatives for PHD and advises new software away from the deprecated VisualPHD API. VECTOR therefore targets current read-first interfaces only.

customerValue: Bring historian/process evidence into labour and production intelligence without depending on deprecated VisualPHD integrations.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce manual historian exports and legacy-interface maintenance in workforce-production analysis.
constraintsRisks: PHD version, API packaging, on-prem routing and security configuration are customer specific; edge connectivity is assumed until proven otherwise.

systems.name: SafetyChain QMS
systems.evidenceNote: SafetyChain documents REST APIs for record extraction, supplier onboarding and process/resource operations. Some endpoints can mutate records/resources, so VECTOR remains read-only until tenant-specific least-privilege evidence is proven.
securityEvidenceBlockers: No customer-tenant integration user or role-scope evidence has been captured for VECTOR.
Process APIs include mutating operations; exact least-privilege permissions and approval boundaries must be proven before any write-capable maturity level.

customerValue: Correlate quality records and tasks with workforce availability, skills and production decisions.
savingsHypotheses: Reduce manual quality-to-workforce reconciliation and surface labour-related quality risk earlier.
constraintsRisks: Environment-specific bearer tokens, admin permissions and write-capable endpoints require strict tenant evidence and read-only defaults.
